d: Long, charcoal-grey hair with straight-cut bangs and a flowing ponytail is paired with narrow, golden-amber eyes and a youthful, mature expression. The slender build is dressed in a dark navy and black military-style tunic with silver buttons and a white underskirt, complemented by a white cloak draped over one shoulder and thigh-high black leather boots. Signature details include a black headpiece with silver ornaments, a brown leather utility pouch at the hip, and a green handheld device held in a black gloved hand.
